An unhurried conversational glance toward the off-screen protagonist, with her stance still oriented along the microwave counter.

captured_moment.before: After both meal boxes have been handed over, Xu has advanced to the checkout microwave counter; the protagonist has put away the lit phone and described finishing his software deployment/review.
captured_moment.during: Both dinners are actively heating behind closed oven doors. Xu answers that the client needs the final round in the morning before printing; she glances toward the neighbor without leaving her place at the counter.
captured_moment.after: The work clarification continues until a later completion beep draws her eyes to the ovens; the employee retrieves her dinner later and checkout follows. Retrieval and beep are not simultaneous actions in this image.

action_flow.before: She followed the queue forward and surrendered her dinner for heating, retaining coffee in her right hand and freeing the left.
action_flow.during: She waits within a small step of the microwave counter, torso still angled toward it, head turned lightly to the off-screen neighbor; bottle upright against a relaxed bent right forearm, left hand empty near waist.
action_flow.after: She will turn her attention toward the completion sound and later take back her meal before paying; no reach or button press is underway now.

environment_coupling.anchor: Customer side of the checkout counter directly beside the two stacked microwaves heating their separate meals.
environment_coupling.interaction: Her waiting position and counter-facing torso remain tied to the oven queue while only head/eyes address the neighbor. Closed oven mesh with restrained heating glow makes the pause observable; counter edge passes behind her waist without a leaned-on pose.

physical_cues.support: Body supported by both feet on the dry tile outside the waist-up crop; grounded upright pelvis and lowered shoulders, no floating lean or contact with unseen person.
physical_cues.contact: Right fingers encircle the coffee bottle with visible thumb opposition; left fingers remain separate and empty near waist, not touching an oven. Tote strap bears against left shoulder and side of sweater.
physical_cues.weight: Bottle hangs vertically from supported right grip with elbow below wrist; resting weight settles through hips, left shoulder receives the soft tote load, no levitating props.
physical_cues.material_response: Grey knit compresses slightly at bent elbows and beneath tote strap, relaxed cloth folds fall from waist; canvas creases under gravity, bottle catches narrow fluorescent highlights, metal oven faces carry softer cool reflections distinct from wet background glass.

depth_staging.midground: Xu and her bottle/empty left hand share the conversational plane beside the counter; two stacked microwave fronts just to her screen right recede slightly behind her, neither intersects her hands or face.
depth_staging.background: Storefront glass and wet blue street reflections behind counter/refrigerator aisle, distant packages soft and unbranded, no human figures/reflections.
depth_staging.subject_separation: Cool counter and darker blue window separate grey sweater and brown hair; physical overlap at tote/shoulder and crisp hand/bottle contact define the subject, moderate optical falloff preserves oven edges without studio outline/rim glow.
